subject: Acceptance phasing proposal + request to resequence MAP timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lifescan.ai>, Samantha Lee <procurement@lifescan.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance phasing proposal + attached MAP v3

Ethan / Samantha —

Following our call yesterday I attached a revised MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) and an updated evaluation plan (eval-plan.pdf). Key changes:

- Split acceptance into two phases: Phase A (integration + smoke tests) and Phase B (feature-complete acceptance).
- Target Phase A sign-off window moved earlier to reduce overall customer risk (we think this reduces exposure to procurement gating).
- Proposed cutover weekend: 2028-06-10 to 2028-06-11 for Phase A; Phase B pilot window: 2028-07-15 to 2028-07-22.

Can you confirm the stakeholder list and procurement windows on your side? If procurement needs a formal SOW to unblock the PO, we included a SOW_draft.docx for your legal / procurement review.

If the procurement timeline is longer than expected we have two contingency options: 1) a limited feature pilot that requires only minimal procurement approvals, or 2) a paid pilot on Redwood Dedicated for a short window to demonstrate latency/cost metrics while procurement completes the PO.

Please flag which path is feasible by EOD Monday so we can finalize the canary plan.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: eval-plan.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: SOW_draft.docx (docx)

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lifescan.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <procurement@lifescan.ai>, Alice Garner <alice.garner@lifescan.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance phasing proposal + attached MAP v3
Olga —

Thanks for the clean MAP and options. High level: procurement is backed up this quarter due to a vendor consolidation on our side, so the formal PO path will likely take until mid-July. That pushes our Phase B sign-off beyond the dates you suggested.

Samantha: procurement will need a redlined SOW, an SOC2 addendum (we saw your SOC2 link in the portal) and a brief runbook that shows rollback/escrow for the first 30 days.
For Phase A we can probably do a limited integration pilot in late June (target week of 2028-06-24) but it will be scoped to only two endpoints and 10k monthly tokens. If Redwood can guarantee isolation and a defined rollback, procurement might greenlight that sooner.
I’ve attached some internal procurement notes — mainly timing constraints.
Appreciate the contingency options; for us the critical path is the PO. If there’s anything you can do on the SOW speedup (a simplified addendum or a temporary MSA change), that would help.
—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Product, Lifescan AI
Attachment: procurement-notes.txt (text)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lifescan.ai>, Samantha Lee <procurement@lifescan.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance phasing proposal + attached MAP v3
Ethan / Samantha —

Thanks for the clarity. Quick sketch of an operational path that keeps the calendar moving:

1) Late-June limited integration (Phase A-lite) — two endpoints, 10k tokens/month, Redwood Hosted API with strict data isolation and a documented rollback. We’ll provide a 30-day runbook and keep logs/audit access for your security team.
2) While Phase A-lite runs, timeline for full PO + SOW negotiation continues; target full acceptance window for Phase B moved to 2028-08-01 through 2028-08-15 (tentative).
3) If procurement cannot sign by 2028-07-20 we’ll elevate: sales credit or short-term paid sandbox on Dedicated while procurement finalizes. We’ll need a quick exec sign from Lifescan to approve a paid pilot.
Next steps: Samantha, can you confirm the SOW redline owner and whether a simplified addendum (2 pages) would be acceptable to accelerate PO? If yes, Olga and I will push an addendum template today and get DocuSign out.
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Acceptance phasing proposal + attached MAP v3 — escalation note
Marissa / Ben —
Looping you both in because procurement at Lifescan has pushed the PO timeline and that materially shifts our close plan. Key points:

- Customer committed to a Phase A-lite late June (two endpoints, 10k tokens). That preserves some telemetry but pushes full acceptance to August.
- Procurement asked for SOW redlines + SOC2 addendum + 30-day rollback runbook. Jordan will prepare the addendum but we should decide if we offer a temporary sandbox credit (30% off first month) to minimize churn risk while procurement completes the PO.
- Risk: shifting Phase B to August will move revenue recognition and may create a gap in the quarterly forecast for Q3. If we maintain a paid sandbox as bridge, we reduce churn but increase near-term discount exposure.

Propose we do the following:
1) Approve Jordan to send a two-page SOW addendum and DocuSign package today.
2) Approve up to one month of sandbox credit (limit $25k) contingent on a signed Letter of Intent from Lifescan committing to the August acceptance window.
3) Ben, please prep a 1-pager for CSM onboarding to keep technical momentum during the limited Phase A.
If we agree, I’ll coordinate the DocuSign push and the sandbox provisioning.
Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
